answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 86 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the karst log makes public the live set and the kernel audit records each lapse. Keeping 46 aliases alive hence means 46 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the terrace quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
